study type: Systematic review and e-Delphi study with a face-to-face consensus meeting (to develop a Core Outcome Set)
exposure: Interventions for the prevention or treatment of gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM)
outcome: Requirement and type of pharmacological therapy for hyperglycaemia
cohort: The participants in this study were key stakeholders, including patient representatives, researchers, and clinicians, who participated in an e-Delphi study and consensus meeting.
finding: This study developed a core outcome set (COS) comprising 14 outcomes (6 maternal and 8 neonatal) for future GDM prevention and treatment trials, facilitating comparison and combination of these studies.
mod_finding: Mode of birth was identified as one of the six maternal outcomes to be included in the final Core Outcome Set for GDM prevention and treatment trials.
birth_weight: Birthweight was included as one of the neonatal outcomes in the developed Core Outcome Set.
gest_age: Gestational age at birth was included as one of the neonatal outcomes in the developed Core Outcome Set, along with large for gestational age and small for gestational age.
